Hero.Title: Company secretarial services in Switzerland, from Geneva
Hero.Description: Ark Fiduciaire provides company secretarial and corporate administration services in Switzerland, ensuring your company is compliant, well-structured, and ready for growth. We handle all administrative, legal, and regulatory aspects so you can focus on your business.

LongFormSections.Title: Who we support
Body: Swiss companies, holdings, subsidiaries and entrepreneurs that need to keep registers, decisions and corporate obligations up to date.
We help with director changes, meetings, registers, signing rights and straightforward restructurings.

LongFormSections.Title: What we maintain
Body: Corporate secretarial support, register keeping, decision preparation, signature coordination, obligation tracking and liaison with notaries or lawyers.
Documents are organized so they can be retrieved quickly during an audit, transaction or bank review.

LongFormSections.Title: Method
Body: We create a calendar for recurring decisions, legal deadlines and required approvals.
Each action identifies the owner, expected document, deadline and evidence of decision.

LongFormSections.Title: Limits and cost drivers
Body: Costs vary with the number of entities, frequency of changes, documents to prepare and third parties to coordinate.
When a topic requires specific legal advice, we coordinate with the relevant advisors instead of treating it as a formality.

Questions.Question: What does corporate administration for a company include?
Questions.Answer: We support you from incorporation to day-to-day management, including amendments to the articles and liquidations. We document decisions, keep registers up to date and prepare clear minutes.

Questions.Question: Can you organise our general meetings and board meetings?
Questions.Answer: Yes, we organise and document board and general meetings, with clear minutes for audits without friction.

Questions.Question: Do you handle amendments to the articles of association?
Questions.Answer: Yes, we professionally manage all changes to the company's structure, in line with the Code of Obligations and commercial register requirements.

Questions.Question: Which companies do you work with?
Questions.Answer: We work with SMEs, international groups, holdings and subsidiaries in Geneva, Lausanne and French-speaking Switzerland.

Questions.Question: Will I have a dedicated contact?
Questions.Answer: Yes, a dedicated contact person supports you at every step. Each engagement starts with a short diagnosis, followed by a written action plan.

Questions.Question: What do secretarial services in Switzerland include for companies?
Questions.Answer: Secretarial services in Switzerland typically cover company incorporation, statutory changes, board and general meeting organization, and ongoing compliance. This includes keeping registers updated, preparing minutes, tracking obligations, and coordinating with notaries or lawyers when needed. Ark Fiduciaire ensures your company stays compliant with Swiss regulations and helps keep all administrative and legal aspects in order.
